kurz: Mussels steam in wine and shallots until they pop open: their own juice becomes the sauce you mop up with bread.
bild_im_kopf: Like tea bags in hot water: the mussels give their flavour to the broth, and the broth gives it back.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Clean the mussels and discard open ones that won't close
schluesselmomente.warum: Only live mussels are safe. Dead ones spoil quickly.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Soften shallots and garlic in butter
schluesselmomente.warum: Their flavours dissolve in the fat and later in the broth.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add white wine, bring to the boil, add the mussels, lid on
schluesselmomente.warum: The steam cooks the mussels from all sides in a few minutes.

schluesselmomente.schritt: After 3 to 5 minutes, once they are open, add parsley and a knob of butter to the broth
schluesselmomente.warum: The cold butter lightly thickens the broth and rounds it out.
